name: Amaree Joshua
strengths: Joshua (#71) fires off the ball with suddenness for a 6-7 frame and consistently wins first contact in the run game.
Joshua drives and finishes — locks, rides edge defenders 5+ yards, and pancakes with a nasty closing demeanor.
Joshua climbs to the second level with clean angles and engulfs LBs/DBs in space (open-field finish to the boundary).
Joshua covers ground in kick-slide, delivers a heavy initial punch, and mirrors inside counters while anchoring vs bull rush.
weaknesses: Joshua occasionally pops high out of his stance and bends at the waist — pad level vs SEC edge speed needs knee-bend consistency.
Joshua’s punch can land wide on the shoulder pads — hand placement must tighten when length alone does not win.
comparison: Joshua comps to Walker Little — 6-7 / ~315 tackle mold with rare length who grows mass and wins with reach/frame (size-matched within ~1–2" of Joshua's 6-7 / 288).
projection: Joshua projects as develop into the OL room, earn early depth and swing-tackle snaps, then compete for a starting OT job — starter upside as a length-first tackle.
schemeFit: Joshua fits a length-first LT/RT who can grow starter mass in a power/zone hybrid room that wants finish and edge seal.
insiderNotes: Joshua is Hillgrove LT #71 with rare 6-7 length. Tape: sudden get-off, drive finish/pancakes, second-level climb, heavy punch + kick-slide depth + anchor. Growth: pad level and hand placement. Florida offered Aug 2026; On3 Industry ~86.55; RPM still has Georgia Tech/Georgia out front with Ohio State loud.
